correctness.rationale: The frame operation is exactly existential choice of a neighbourhood contained in the support and intersecting each instance set. Singleton instance sets for every element of D force any witness inside D to equal D, proving reconstruction. For the lower bound, every test with at most n-1 nonempty instance sets has a proper transversal of size at most n-1, so adding only the full carrier as a neighbourhood is invisible below arity n; n singleton tests expose it.

value.rationale: The new duality uses an omega-indexed BAIO signature and explicitly discusses signature reduction. The theorem gives a natural, exact finite compression result: on n worlds the first n instance arities retain all frame information, and no smaller uniform initial segment can do so. The matching lower bound prevents the result from being a routine restatement of the source reconstruction formula.
